messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Generic versions of rosuvastatin tablets may contain different inactive ingredients from those listed above. Check the product label for your particular formulation for a complete list of ingredients.
Triplet: ["rosuvastatin", "has inactive ingredient", "tribasic calcium phosphate NF"]

The relation 'has inactive ingredient' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug contains the inactive substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
